# Base image with Flux, OpenMPI, and AWS EFA support for ARM
FROM ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-openmpi:ubuntu2204-efa-arm

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Set OSU Benchmarks version
ENV OSU_VERSION=7.3

# Install build dependencies, certificates, and download utilities
# Then, download, compile, and install the OSU benchmarks
# The build is configured to use the MPI compilers from the base image
# Finally, clean up the source files to reduce image size
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    wget \
    tar \
    autoconf \
    automake \
    libtool && \
    \
    # Create a temporary directory for the build
    cd /tmp && \
    \
    # Download the OSU benchmarks source code
    wget "https://mvapich.cse.ohio-state.edu/download/mvapich/osu-micro-benchmarks-${OSU_VERSION}.tar.gz" && \
    tar -xzf "osu-micro-benchmarks-${OSU_VERSION}.tar.gz" && \
    cd "osu-micro-benchmarks-${OSU_VERSION}" && \
    \
    # FIX: Removed unnecessary './bootstrap' call. The distribution tarball already contains a configure script.
    # Configure the build to use mpicc and mpicxx, enabling MPI support.
    ./configure CC=mpicc CXX=mpicxx && \
    \
    # Compile the benchmarks
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    \
    # Find all compiled MPI benchmark executables and copy them to /usr/local/bin to be on the PATH
    # This ensures multi-node compatibility as executables are in a standard system location.
    find . -type f -executable -path '*/mpi/*' -exec cp {} /usr/local/bin/ \; && \
    \
    # Clean up build artifacts and source code
    cd / && \
    rm -rf "/tmp/osu-micro-benchmarks-${OSU_VERSION}" "/tmp/osu-micro-benchmarks-${OSU_VERSION}.tar.gz" && \
    \
    # Clean up apt cache
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# This MiniCluster manifest is configured to run the OSU AllReduce benchmark
# on an AWS EKS cluster with ARM-based instances and EFA networking.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster job.
  name: osu-allreduce-aws-arm
  # The job will be deployed in the 'default' namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster, corresponding to one pod per node.
  size: 4

  # The total number of MPI tasks to run. We'll run one task per pod/node.
  tasks: 4

  # Do not delete pods after the job completes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Enable strict logging for better debugging.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Configuration for the Flux Framework broker and associated settings.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for the flux view tools.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # This is a special setting to run flux broker within the main application container
      # instead of a separate sidecar. This is required by the prompt.
      disable: true
      # An ARM-compatible image for the flux view tools is required.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy

  # Defines the container that will run the HPC application.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:osu-allreduce
      # The command to execute. The Flux Operator will prepend `flux run -n <tasks>` to this.
      command: osu_allreduce
      # Ensure the latest version of the container is always pulled.
      imagePullPolicy: Always
      # This container is a worker, not the main job launcher.
      # This MUST be false for worker pods.
      launcher: false
      # Resource requests and limits are essential for scheduling pods on nodes
      # with specific hardware, such as AWS EFA for high-performance networking.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: "1"

    restartPolicy: Never

    # Specify the architecture for the flux view tools.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # This is a special setting to run the flux broker within the main application container

      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy

    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:osu-allreduce

      command: osu_allreduce
      # Ensure the latest version of the container is always pulled.
      imagePullPolicy: Always
      # This container is a worker, not the main job launcher.

      launcher: false

      environment:
        FI_PROVIDER: efa
        RDMAV_FORK_SAFE: "1"

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: osu-allreduce-aws-arm
  namespace: default
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: osu_allreduce
    environment:
      FI_PROVIDER: efa
      RDMAV_FORK_SAFE: '1'
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:osu-allreduce
    imagePullPolicy: Always
    launcher: false
    resources:
      limits:
        vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: '1'
      requests:
        vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: '1'
  flux:
    arch: arm
    container:
      disable: true
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy
  logging:
    strict: true
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: m7g.16xlarge
    restartPolicy: Never
  size: 4
  tasks: 256

manager.name: Build and Deploy OSU AllReduce
manager.description: Build a Docker container and deploy it as a Kubernetes Job.

context.environment: AWS CPU instance in Kubernetes to run across nodes
context.details:
You MUST use ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-openmpi:ubuntu2204-efa-arm as a base image. It includes OpenMPI and libfabric provided from the efa installer for AWS and the entire Flux Framework stack.
You MUST compile setting the cxx compiler to mpicxx and the c compiler to mpicc.
Build the OSU benchmarks. You MUST have MPI support enabled. You MUST ensure osu_allreduce is on the path.
You MUST build for a multi-node MPI environment

context.resources: The resource spec you got earlier is for an autoscaling cluster, so the nodes possible are not there. You must add the nodeSelector to use node.kubernetes.io/instance-type m7g.16xlarge with 64 CPU, 256 GiB Memory, ARM (Graviton3). You are limited to up to 4 nodes.
context.details:
Run The OSU All Reduce benchmark across 4 nodes. 
You MUST run on up to 4 nodes and you MUST set flux.container.disable to true.
You MUST set the containers imagePullPolicy to Always.
The Flux Operator uses flux run in the pwd with the tasks determined by the spec.tasks.
You MUST set resource requests and limits to use vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
Since this is an ARM instance you MUST change the flux.container.image to be
ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy and set flux.arch: "arm".
